name: github-pr-card
description: GitHub pull requests in Claude Code: an inline card (/pr), a PR bar above the prompt (/pr-band), checks, reviews, unresolved threads and Fix with Claude.

pollSeconds.title: Background refresh (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often a card with pending checks refreshes while it was viewed in the last 30 minutes. 0 turns background refresh off.

autoAttach.title: Attach cards to gh pr create and git push
autoAttach.description: Draw the card under successful `gh pr create`, `gh pr view` or `git push` rows.

prBar.title: PR bar above the prompt
prBar.description: auto: shows when the session's branch has a PR or Claude pushes one (✕ hides it for the session). manual: only after /pr-band.
